title: Recent homes sales in Greater Boston (Aug. 5)
author: The Boston Globe
bullets: Abington's 22 Nardone Circle, a 3,512 sq. ft. Colonial home, sold for $1,185,000.
An Andover Colonial on Barron Court, built in 2007, sold for $2,400,000.
A one-family ranch on 4 Andover Road in Beverly was purchased for $852,500.

title: Jarren Duran: ‘I thought I was going to be released’ by Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jarren Duran, Red Sox outfielder, feared release due to poor performance but remains on the team.
Duran expressed gratitude for staying post-trade deadline, aiming for a 20-20 season despite struggles.
Duran acknowledged criticism for on-field outbursts, remains hopeful to contribute to team's playoff push.

title: Wu, Councilor Louijeune lead more than 100 elected officials in urging Congress to extend protections for Haitians
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Boston Mayor Michelle Wu and Councilor Ruthzee Louijeune lead over 100 officials urging Congress to extend TPS for Haitians.
The officials' letter to the U.S. Senate seeks to extend TPS for Haitians through early 2029 after a Supreme Court ruling.
TPS holders, many in Massachusetts, contribute significantly to the economy; ending TPS risks economic and social disruption.

title: Durbin hits grand slam and Abreu goes deep twice as streaking Red Sox rout White Sox 14-2
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Red Sox's Caleb Durbin hit a first-inning grand slam as Boston defeated Chicago White Sox 14-2 at Fenway Park.
Wilyer Abreu contributed with two solo home runs; Red Sox hit four homers for the second consecutive game.
Patrick Sandoval earned his first win since 2024, striking out five over five-plus innings for Boston.

title: What Adley Rutschman said about joining Red Sox after blockbuster trade
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquired catcher Adley Rutschman from the Orioles in exchange for Carlos Narvaez and several prospects.
Rutschman is recovering from wrist inflammation, with no set timeline for his return to the field.
Interim manager Chad Tracy emphasizes Rutschman as a major addition to the lineup and catching position.

title: Lawsuit against Suffolk DA, BPD aims to force release of footage of fatal police shooting in Roxbury
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Lawyers for Civil Rights sued Boston Police and Suffolk DA for withholding footage of Stephenson King's fatal police shooting.
The March 11 shooting by Officer Nicholas O'Malley in Roxbury led to charges of manslaughter against him.
The lawsuit challenges the state's investigatory exemption law and seeks the release of body-camera and dashboard footage.

title: Could Roman Anthony, Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox this season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Roman Anthony progresses to batting practice, eyeing potential Red Sox return in September.
Garrett Crochet resumes light throwing after two-month hiatus, future return still uncertain.
Trevor Story approaches rehab assignment, Isiah Kiner-Falefa and Kutter Crawford remain without return timelines.

title: ‘We’ve got to make up for lost time’: After lengthy absence, Gabe Jacas faces a new challenge
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Gabe Jacas, a New England Patriots rookie, finally signed a 4-year contract worth up to $8.6 million.
Jacas missed early practices due to contract negotiations and injury concerns but has now joined training camp.
Patriots coach Mike Vrabel emphasized the need for Jacas to catch up due to his absence from initial sessions.

title: Skeletal remains found in South Boston home turn out to be animal bones, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Police found skeletal remains at 8 Glover Court in South Boston, later identified as animal bones.
Officers discovered shoes in a bag near the remains after speaking with people working on the home.
The Suffolk District Attorney's office confirmed the bones were not human, and the investigation remains active.

title: Drake Maye, offense finish strong and other takeaways from Day 9 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye ended Patriots practice strong, completing 11 of his last 12 passes in the two-minute drill.
A.J. Brown successfully overcame a dislocated thumb incident, participating fully in Tuesday's practice.
Linebacker Chad Muma is rising in the Patriots' depth chart, potentially becoming the third linebacker.
